g.text: All times are ms; 1,000 ticks per process. Top table ends at sender flush; completion waits are in the data.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #787466

g.text: A 32-packet credit window per flow prevents local drops. Receive CPU includes polling/copy, not application decode.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #787466

g.text: Sender and aggregate receiver CPU are separate; this measures one controlled loopback host, not Internet capacity.
